plainText:
Laurie Hymes is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Hymes was born on March 5, 1982, in San Diego, California. As an adult, she became a voice actress in 2013 and immediately started out working for the English-dubbed versions of a number of foreign series. In 2014, she began working for during and eventually landed two of her best-known roles: Team Flare scientist Mable, who appeared in Pokémon the Series: XY; and , a main character in . Hymes currently resides in New York City, New York, with her husband, Ryan Nicolls, who has also voiced characters in Pokémon.
